verdict.rationale: A probe confirmed a live llms.txt at docs.withpersona.com that includes explicit "Instructions for AI Agents", such as appending .md to any page for clean Markdown. A versioned llms.txt (2025-12-08) indexes the doc pages as Markdown links, and the cited doc pages are served as .md URLs. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of an agent actually consuming these docs effectively.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote:
## Instructions for AI Agents

- For clean Markdown of any page, append `.md` to the page URL
[Webhook Event Filters](https://docs.withpersona.com/webhook-event-filters.md): Only have a subset of Events come through
